title: We read 170,000 Instagram DMs. Here is where the sales died.
desc: A sales audit of a seven-channel Instagram resale team: 3,455 conversations scored, 30% of new leads paid, 1,034 went silent after the price. What the numbers say and what to fix first.

title: 11.1M views in 107 days, with no post scheduled by hand
desc: How a 150k-follower resale brand on Instagram reached 11.1M views in 107 days with a content engine, one calendar and publishing that runs itself. Real numbers from Metricool.

title: How to run Instagram DMs with a team of managers
desc: A practical playbook for brands that sell through Instagram DMs with several managers: one inbox, ownership, a reply-time clock, follow-ups, and the five numbers to watch every morning.
